validator_dependency: Existing OMSI validator tooling (PR #53); extend in place, do not create a new validator.

semantics.qualified_for_declared_profile: Evidence satisfies the exact profile's declared admission predicates. This is not a regulatory or field certification.
semantics.degraded: A weaker profile-permitted service mode is evidenced; authority and confidence must be attenuated accordingly.
semantics.indeterminate: Evidence is incomplete, contradictory, stale, or not sufficient to determine reliance.
semantics.reject_reliance: A specific input or claim violates a required validity predicate.
semantics.not_authorized: Evidence assessment may exist, but no protected operation permission is present.
semantics.not_comparable: The profile, source, threshold, measurement or evaluation basis cannot be matched.

constraints: All vectors are synthetic and contain no real receiver data or facility identifiers.
No vector authorizes physical actuation or protected operational changes.
A model score is not a source signature, calibration certificate, integrity guarantee, cause attribution or operation permit.
A no-declared-common-domain relation is scoped to complete declared inventories and one immutable dependency snapshot; it does not prove physical independence.
Sector thresholds are supplied by the selected profile authority; this pack defines no universal accuracy, freshness, alert or availability threshold.

assertions: Source identity, calibration, time and configuration remain separately visible.
Qualification is bound to the declared telecom profile and exact evidence snapshot.
No universal Good/Degraded threshold is created.
Freshness cannot override explicit integrity invalidity.
A new fix does not automatically set navigation health to qualified.
Authenticated identity does not imply current calibration.
Recent data cannot restore permission to rely on an expired calibration.
Incompatible numeric timestamps are not directly compared.
Missing clock correlation is not silently treated as UTC.
Six sources sharing a time reference do not count as six independent time witnesses.
The pairwise graph identifies shared clock dependencies and exact snapshot/as-of.
Missing dependency inventory yields unknown.
No declared overlap with incomplete inventories is not independence.
Profiles from different immutable dependency snapshots cannot be combined into one graph.
A source used by the detector cannot be represented as an independent oracle source for the same claim.
Physical-event truth, receiver-integrity truth and service consequence remain distinct.
The anomaly is preserved as an observation.
Cause and actor attribution are not invented.
Symthaea may retain competing hypotheses and abstain.
Unknown RF family does not imply maliciousness, physical emitter identity/location, or invalid PNT.
RF open-set output is not silently promoted into a PNT integrity verdict.
Degraded acquisition is distinct from unknown signal class.
A high classifier score cannot repair invalid capture-chain evidence.
Communications loss alone does not invalidate locally evidenced navigation.
Unavailable remote context remains explicit and does not grant new authority.
Anomaly disappearance does not automatically restore normal service.
The state remains recovering or degraded until requalification.
Recovery is a new qualification event.
The profile's re-entry condition is explicit.
No cognitive component grants operational authority.
A recommendation cannot authorize an operation.
Exact target/action/tenant/authority checks remain in existing Platform effect boundary.
Positive predicted EVSI is not permission to execute.
Missing probe impact evidence is unknown, not zero.
Probe timeout does not prove acquisition stopped.
